name: Clean House: co-op acceptance
notes: The mission for the co-op record (docs/coop-record.md): one modded host, at least one friend without the mod. Every feature below is used once, so each row of the record has one place to look.
Start enemies: five guards in the house and one patrol walking the yard north of it (route from Clean House: Open Door).
Zone trigger 1 'At the door': walking up to the front door brings two patrols from the north and unlocks and opens the upstairs door that starts locked.
Repeating trigger 2 'Every ninety seconds': a timer at 60 s that fires again every 90 s, three times in all, and brings one wanderer each time.
Doors: 'Door Interior Paneled_3' upstairs starts locked (trigger 1 unlocks and opens it); taking the phone closes and locks the back door 'Door Exterior Paneled_3'.
Moved intel: the phone is laid upstairs at (-20.75, 4.78, 6.5) instead of the game's own place. Trigger 3 'Phone taken' fires when any phone of the set is picked up.
Countdown: trigger 5 'Out of time' starts with the phone and tells the players at the start, at one minute and at ten seconds.
Two messages at once: triggers 3 and 4 both speak the moment the phone is taken; the second must follow the first, not replace it.
Extraction held: the extraction stays shut until trigger 4 'Extraction open' has fired, which is when the phone is taken.
Shared respawn: 20 seconds after the first death everyone who is dead comes back together, two waves at most.

Success ending: trigger 7 'Job done' ends the mission as a success once the phone is taken and the officer upstairs is down (trigger 6). Failure ending: trigger 5 ends it as failed three minutes after the phone is taken.
briefing: Take the phone upstairs and kill the officer. The way out stays shut until you hold the phone.
Once you hold it you have three minutes.

triggers.name: At the door
triggers.message: Movement to the north: more of them are coming.

triggers.name: Every ninety seconds
triggers.message: {time} in: one more of them is on the way. {enemies} left.

triggers.name: Phone taken
triggers.message: Phone secured. The back door is locked behind you.

triggers.name: Extraction open
triggers.message: Second message: the extraction is open.
